0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The timid Arkasodara is in need of protection.

25.original: Speak with the timid Arkasodara again.

26.original: Survey the designated locations and defeat any enemies you encounter.

28.original: Speak with the timid Arkasodara again.

48.original: You look pretty strong. Do you think you could help me?

49.original: I need someone to guard me while I gather Agni grass for my medicines.

50.original: Its scent is difficult to follow, even for we Arkasodara. I can't concentrate and watch my back at the same time.

51.original: Please. I'm afraid some beast will strike me while my guard is down.

52.original: I'm in your debt. I'll sniff out some Agni grass, so follow me.

54.original: There. It's faint, but I can smell the grass from that way. Let's go.

55.original: This is it! Agni grass! I'll grab a few bundles, you keep watch. I'd hate to get eaten so close to my goal...

56.original: Stand guard while I gather up this grass.

57.original: Thank you for watching over me! I got all sorts of ingredients, even more than I hoped for.

58.original: All thanks to you. If you weren't here, I would have been too scared to─ What was that...? Perhaps we should continue our talks back at the Great Work.

59.original: Whew, we made it back in one piece. I really can't thank you enough. With your brawn and my nose, I got enough Agni grass to solve a whole army's digestive issues.

60.original: Having olfactory senses five times as strong as your average Midlander's comes in handy sometimes.

61.original: This place can be a bit much, though. So many smells mingling and clashing, and all of them so strong...

62.original: Anyway, thank you again, kind adventurer. Please, take this.
